artworks.title: Saints Cosmas and Damian Caring for the Sick
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in various poses. One central figure is seated with a regal posture, wearing a robe and a cap. Other figures around him are engaged in different actions, such as examining or sitting. The figures are clothed in robes or draped fabrics with detailed folds. In the background, there are dramatic draperies, two putti or cherubs, and faint architectural features for depth.

artworks.title: A Bizarre Rock Formation
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large, abstract rocky formation in dark charcoal against a light background. The texture is rough with shades of black and gray. The rock is on the right side with a faint outline on the left. The darker areas and lighter patches suggest depth and contours. In the bottom left corner, there is a signature with two initials.

artworks.title: Chiron Teaching Music to Achilles
artworks.artist: Gaetano Zompini after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring mythological creatures under a tree engaging in music and study. The drawing depicts two figures sitting beneath a large, twisting tree, surrounded by lush foliage. One figure holds a stringed instrument, possibly a lute or guitar, while studying a book alongside an older, bearded figure who also appears engrossed in a large, open book. An array of objects, including a globe, lie at their feet. On the right, a centaur reclines against a stone structure adorned with intricate carvings. The scene is detailed, capturing textures of bark, leaves, and stone, as well as the motion of the figures.

artworks.title: Steffan Wolters
artworks.artist: Jan Verkolje I after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest upwards. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side and is wearing a dark garment with a light-colored shirt underneath. Their right hand is partially visible holding the garment. The person has distinct facial features, including a pointed nose and closed lips, with their eyes looking directly at the viewer. They have long, wavy hair falling around their shoulders. The background is plain, and at the bottom of the portrait, the name "Steffan Wolters" is inscribed, along with a signature and additional text.

artworks.title: Apollo
artworks.artist: comte de Anne-Claude-Philippe de Tubières Caylus after Edme Bouchardon
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure standing on a cloud holding a staff. The figure is nude with one arm crossing their body and the other raised to touch their hair. The figure has one foot balanced on a cloud. Beside the figure are a staff, a bow, and a lyre on the ground. In the background is an oval frame with detailed hatching for depth. The figure's gaze is towards a floating emblem resembling a hand or flame in a circle. The drawing is intricately detailed with fine lines as seen in engraving.

artworks.title: Bacchus
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of two figures within an oval frame. The main figure is a reclining man with a muscular build, shown from the upper body up. He has one arm around his head and holds a reed or staff with leaves in his left hand. The second figure, a cherubic child, is pouring liquid from a jug into the man's mouth. Both figures are nude, with the man partially covered by a cloth. The background includes foliage and hints of distant clouds.

artworks.title: Justus Lipsius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with his upper body slightly angled and his head turned to the side. His facial features include a prominent brow, deeply set eyes, a straight nose, and a full beard with a mustache. His hair is short and neat with a distinguished hairline. The man is wearing a high, pleated ruff collar, a fur-lined coat, and a buttoned garment underneath. He holds a small book in one hand and a realistic mask resembling an animal's head in the other. The background is a plain backdrop. An inscription in Latin is at the top, with additional text at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Toilet of Venus
artworks.medium: pen and ink over red and black chalk with wash and heightening on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, an adult and a child. The adult is seated and leans forward, reaching towards the child. The adult has sharp facial features, styled hair, and is draped in flowing garments. The child is depicted from the back, seated with one leg raised, wearing minimal clothing. The adult's hand supports the child's back in a tender manner. The background is simple, emphasizing the figures, with shading for depth. The scene is rendered in a sketch-like style with cross-hatching and shading.

artworks.title: A Path through Fields near Leipzig
artworks.medium: graphite and wash on slightly blued laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a winding path through a natural landscape, with soft strokes defining the horizon line and delicate brushstrokes conveying texture in the grasses and rocks. The color palette is muted, primarily in shades of beige and grey. Closest to us, tufts of grass and small stones populate the path, which becomes more surrounded by taller grasses as it extends into the distance.

artworks.title: Christ Crucified between Two Thieves
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: An Extensive View in Shropshire
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated point of view overlooking a vast landscape. The horizon is high, with distant hills or mountains barely visible. The brushstrokes are gentle and fluid, giving the painting a soft quality. The color palette is muted, with soft whites, beige, green, and pink. The foreground shows subtle variations in color suggesting grassy and earthy textures. A cluster of trees is on the left, adding depth. In the distance, the landscape extends under a cloudy sky, blending with the background's muted tones.

artworks.title: A Wooded Lane near Ross
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This image features a winding path through a wooded area, with the horizon high near the top edge of the image. Tall trees with overhanging branches, a patch of blue sky, and dense foliage are depicted with a watercolor technique. The color palette consists of earth tones, green, brown, and touches of blue. The path leads into a shadowed area in the distance.

artworks.title: Panorama of the Coast at Sunset
artworks.medium: brown wash with white heightening on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 13.9 x 34.1 cm (5 1/2 x 13 7/16 in.)
overall: 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing depicting the meeting of the sky and land. The horizon line is slightly above the center, with an open, barren landscape. The artwork features broad brushstrokes creating textures and tones. The color scheme is monochromatic, with warm sepia tones creating an aged atmosphere. The scene transitions from darker tones in the foreground to lighter tones in the sky, with clouds adding depth.

artworks.title: Saint Michael Defeating Heresy and Satan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening on blue laid paper, rubbed on verso with red chalk and incised for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial battle scene with mythical creatures. The image depicts two opposing forces engaged in a struggle. The central focus is a cross held by a winged figure, surrounded by clouds. Below are chaotic figures with twisted bodies and monstrous features. The drawing features intricate line work, dynamic poses, and is rendered on blue-toned paper. Contrasting light and shadow through shading enhance the depth and intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: The  Adoration of the Magi
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius in the style of Lucas van Leyden
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with several individuals. In the foreground, a woman is seated, holding a child on her lap. The child has a halo around their head. To the woman's side, a bearded elder is kneeling and offering a container with an open lid to the child. Behind them, several standing men are dressed in robes and cloaks. Two men in the background are holding chalices. The backdrop features architecture with arches and towers. There is also a depiction of clouds and a star overhead. Various observers in attire with head coverings are seen in the middle and background. The scene is executed in detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
artworks.artist: Helias van den Bossche after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 28.7 x 18.1 cm (11 5/16 x 7 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman positioned in the center. She is seated on a crescent moon amidst clouds and heavenly beings. The woman has long, wavy hair, wearing a flowing robe. She has a serene expression with palms pressed together. A child rests on her lap, partially covered in a cloth. Stars form a halo above her head. The background includes swirling clouds and cherubic figures holding a crown above her head. Radiant beams emanate from her head.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape with a Mausoleum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees on either side, a high horizon showcasing rolling hills and distant mountains with faint outlines of more mountains in the background. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, particularly in the trees and land textures. The color scheme is monochromatic, primarily in various shades of brown. A rocky outcrop with a tree, a small structure, and sheep grazing is on the left, while two figures sit with sheep on the right.

artworks.title: Venetian Fantasy with the Dogana
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink over graphite with gray wash and white heightening on blue laid paper, rubbed on verso with red chalk and partly indented for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with buildings lining the horizon, the sea, and the sky above. The style is detailed and features precise lines and soft gray tones. People are shown on the quay engaged in various activities, with boats and additional figures visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Venetian Fantasy with an Ornamental Arch
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink over graphite with gray wash and white heightening on blue laid paper, rubbed on verso with red chalk and partly indented for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with various people and boats nearby, next to a large architectural structure. In the foreground, a small boat is being rowed by two men, with one rowing and the other talking to a woman by some stone steps. The entrance to the architectural structure, decorated with columns and archwork, is visible to the left. More people are walking by the canal, and additional boats are on the water. The horizon is low, with buildings and a sailboat in the distance. The sky above is filled with clouds and birds. The color scheme is mainly bluish-grey, creating a soft, muted look with shadows and highlights providing depth.

artworks.title: Roses
artworks.artist: Richard Earlom after Dr. Robert John Thornton
artworks.medium: color mezzotint and etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III in honor of Gregory E. Mescha
artworks.description: The image shows large blooming roses in colors like white, pink, and yellow, surrounded by leaves and stems. Two birds are perched near the center, with a nest containing three eggs in the lower right. A dragonfly hovers above the flowers. The color palette includes blues, greens, and earth tones, along with vivid flower hues. The roses and leaves are in the central and lower parts, with the birds centrally located and the dragonfly slightly higher. In the background on the far left, an architectural structure is partially visible.

artworks.title: Vulcan Discovering Venus and Mars
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, black wash and white gouache on brown prepared laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: This painting depicts a nighttime scene with a couple on a bed in a dark room illuminated by a strong beam of light. A figure in a hooded cloak with a lantern leans over them, while another figure at the foot of the bed holds a string instrument. The artwork is in the style of Henry Fuseli and features dramatic lighting and expressive emotions.

artworks.title: Head of Christ
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on brown oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Very Reverend and Mrs. Charles U. Harris
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. His head is slightly tilted to the side with a gentle movement in his posture. He has a detailed facial expression with deep-set eyes and a slightly open mouth. His long, wavy hair cascades around his face, and he wears a crown made of thin thorn-like branches. The man's shoulders are visible with minimal clothing detail, suggesting a bare or lightly clothed upper body. The background is a neutral, textured surface providing a warm-toned backdrop to the figure.

artworks.title: A Corner of the Colosseum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Very Reverend and Mrs. Charles U. Harris
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural sketch of ancient Roman arches. The composition leads the eye from the closest arches on the right to those further away. The sketch is done in warm earth tones, primarily browns and tans. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is on the upward angles of the structure where the ruins rise and recede into the distance. The arches are detailed with fine brushstrokes and washes of ink, showcasing textures of stone and climbing plants. Additional structures are visible in the distance, suggesting the vastness of the architectural remains. The image conveys a harmony between the enduring stone and encroaching vegetation.

artworks.title: The Stigmatization of Saint Francis
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monk in a contemplative pose in a wooded landscape. The scene portrays a monk with outstretched arms. There is a cross in the sky among swirling clouds. In the background, a building with spires is visible. Tall trees frame the scene, adding a sense of nature and serenity, while another figure in the background is seen reading a book. The use of expressive lines and soft shading creates depth and atmosphere.
